hook_patterns: Highlighting absurd or ridiculous real-world mistakes caused by psychological illusions.
Exposing deeply frustrating, everyday human behaviors like playing the victim or stealth-flexing wealth.
Presenting a counter-intuitive paradox where our instincts give us the exact wrong answer.
todays_angle: Expose the funny, absurd real-life consequences of classic cognitive biases when Leo and Mia try to outsmart each other.
ideas: Leo tries to rob a bank using invisible ink after learning about the Dunning-Kruger Effect, while Mia documents his overconfident failure.
Mia uses 'Survivorship Bias' to convince Leo that dropping out of college guarantees becoming a billionaire, illustrating the flaw with hilarious examples.
Leo acts like an extreme 'victim mentality' test subject to guilt-trip Mia into buying him lunch, until Mia uses reverse psychology to expose him.
avoid: Generic 'Motivation vs Discipline' gym-bro text slideshows with no character narrative.
Cliché relationship advice videos about what to do when your crush friendzones you.
